MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits my recent TV and video purchases because it could help connect equipment I already have, and its extra length gives me placement flexibility.",
    "My Fire TV purchases make home viewing a reasonable direction to explore, especially when a suggestion adds a useful connection or capability to that setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both HD Fire TV sticks duplicate equipment I already own and offer lower resolution than my existing 4K stick, so their familiarity does not give me a reason to choose them.",
    "The Echo speakers, Echo Auto, and smart plug assume I want more Alexa devices, but my purchases show specific television and security uses rather than a current need for voice assistants or appliance automation.",
    "The earbuds and internal SSD do not serve a current need suggested by my viewing and camera purchases. The Echo Show has a possible camera-viewing use, but I would need confirmed compatibility and a clear purpose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV products seems to have been taken as interest in almost anything with Alexa, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest unrelated electronics or another version of something I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My existing 4K stick and Fire TV television matter: an additional streaming device needs a distinct use or meaningful improvement to interest me.",
    "My recent camera and television purchases suggest practical additions to a home video setup. A useful connection or confirmed camera compatibility matters more to me than sharing a brand or voice assistant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my home viewing interests but stretched them into broad Alexa ownership instead of focusing on useful additions to my existing TV and camera setup."
}
